_comment: Decoration probability tables per biome. ceilingProb = prob of deco tile in air directly above a solid ceiling. wallProb = prob of deco on exposed solid wall face. floorEdgeProb = prob of deco at top of solid surface tile. tileOffset = first tile index in the decoration spritesheet row for this biome (placeholder: 0 until deco spritesheet exists).

earth.description: Stalactites, drip marks, moss patches on wall faces, rubble at base

forest.description: Root hangs from ceiling gaps, vine scatter on walls, dense floor-edge roots and leaf litter

snow.description: Icicle formations, frost patches on wall faces, snow caps on solid surface tops

ruins.description: Crumbled brick scatter on walls, floor rubble, worn surface texture at ground level

dungeon.description: Torch sconces and glyphs on walls, cobweb clusters in corners, stone-crack texture

spirit.description: Glyph marks on walls, ambient glow patches in open space, ethereal wisp scatter

hub.description: Lantern posts above platforms, banner anchor points on walls, lush ground-edge growth
